chain.label: Erroneous 1983 AD compliance entry led Omega to cancel midspar fitting inspections
chain.trigger: a previous owner/operator had marked the compliance status of the AD in effect at the time (77-09-03) with "C" (meaning complete)

chain.label: Older 0.38-inch-radius midspar fitting with fatigue crack remained unreplaced
chain.trigger: the older design fittings had not been replaced with the improved design in accordance with the AD

caused_by.evidence: This status reconfirmed to Omega that the records showed the fittings had been replaced and inspections were no longer necessary, and Omega deleted the inspection requirement from its maintenance plan.

chain.label: No. 2 pylon midspar fitting fractured on takeoff, separating the No. 2 engine and striking off the No. 1 engine inlet cowl
chain.trigger: the No. 2 (left inboard) engine separated and traveled up above the left wing... The inlet cowling for the No. 1 (left outboard) engine separated immediately thereafter, consistent with being struck by the No. 2 engine nacelle

caused_by.evidence: The No. 2 engine pylon midspar fitting had a preexisting fatigue crack that had propagated to a critical length before or during the accident flight takeoff.

chain.label: Significant loss of thrust on the airplane's left side
chain.trigger: resulted in a significant loss of thrust on the left side of the airplane

caused_by.evidence: causing the No. 1 engine inlet cowl to separate, which degraded the engine's ability to produce thrust and resulted in a significant loss of thrust on the left side of the airplane

chain.label: Airplane continued drifting left and would not maintain climb despite full right rudder/aileron
chain.trigger: the airplane continued to drift to the left...he perceived the airplane would not continue to climb

caused_by.evidence: The captain stated that he applied full right rudder and near full right aileron to maintain directional control and level the wings, but the airplane continued to drift to the left.

chain.label: Captain aborted the climb and put the airplane back on the runway
chain.trigger: decided to "put it back on the ground"

caused_by.evidence: The captain reported that he perceived the airplane would not continue to climb and decided to "put it back on the ground."

chain.label: Airplane made multiple hard runway contacts and departed the runway surface
chain.trigger: The airplane made multiple contacts with the runway before drifting left and departing the runway surface

caused_by.evidence: The airplane made multiple contacts with the runway before drifting left and departing the runway surface before the airplane reached taxiway A1.

chain.label: Airplane crossed taxiway A and came to rest in a marsh, substantially damaged by postimpact fire
chain.trigger: the airplane crossed taxiway A and came to rest in the marsh area

caused_by.evidence: The airplane crossed taxiway A and came to rest in the marsh area.

chain.label: Three flight crewmembers sustained minor injuries
chain.trigger: The three flight crewmembers sustained minor injuries

caused_by.evidence: The three flight crewmembers sustained minor injuries.
